name: shinchantw_cbt_week4_guide_duration_20260803_142744_625475
sql:
/*
引导：繁体首日 vs SG 5/9（Android、全体），三个组均用 guide_id + gamer_skip 关联、extra_id<=46。
在线：三组所有有效用户在相对 D1/D2/D3/D4 的日在线时长，不限制首日 cohort。
日在线分钟 = 同账号、同日相邻非 app 事件间隔 0~119 秒的累计。
*/
WITH TCB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SGB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SGC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
SGA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
M AS (SELECT '新加坡全体(iOS+Android)' grp,c.u FROM SGC c UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android' grp,c.u FROM SGC c JOIN SGA a ON c.u=a.u),
GuideCohort AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#distinct_id" did,e."$part_date" d FROM ta.v_event_18 e LEFT JOIN TCB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date"='2026-07-29' AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111') GROUP BY 1,2,3
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,e."#distinct_id",e."$part_date" FROM ta.v_event_13 e JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SGB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date"='2026-05-09' AND b.u IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3),
GuideLogs AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,g."#distinct_id" did,CAST(g.gamer_guide_id AS VARCHAR) gid,COALESCE(TRY_CAST(g.gamer_skip AS INTEGER),0) skip_flag FROM ta.v_event_18 g JOIN GuideCohort c ON c.grp='繁体CBT' AND c.did=g."#distinct_id" AND c.d=g."$part_date" WHERE g."$part_event"='gamer_guide'
 UNION ALL SELECT c.grp,g."#distinct_id",CAST(g.gamer_guide_id AS VARCHAR),COALESCE(TRY_CAST(g.gamer_skip AS INTEGER),0) FROM ta.v_event_13 g JOIN GuideCohort c ON c.grp<>'繁体CBT' AND c.did=g."#distinct_id" AND c.d=g."$part_date" WHERE g."$part_event"='gamer_guide'),
GuideDim AS (SELECT CAST("gamer_guide_id@gamer_guide_id" AS VARCHAR) gid,COALESCE(TRY_CAST("gamer_guide_id@gamer_skip" AS INTEGER),0) skip_flag,COALESCE(TRY_CAST("gamer_guide_id@extra_id" AS INTEGER),0) ord,MAX("gamer_guide_id@guide_name") name FROM ta_dim.dim_13_0_18504 GROUP BY 1,2,3),
GuideAgg AS (SELECT g.grp,COALESCE(d.ord,0) ord,MAX(COALESCE(d.name,CONCAT('步骤ID_',g.gid,'_',CAST(g.skip_flag AS VARCHAR)))) name,COUNT(DISTINCT g.did) users FROM GuideLogs g LEFT JOIN GuideDim d ON g.gid=d.gid AND g.skip_flag=d.skip_flag WHERE (COALESCE(d.ord,0)<=46 OR COALESCE(d.ord,0) BETWEEN 75 AND 83) AND COALESCE(d.ord,0)<>17 AND g.gid NOT IN ('2049','2050') GROUP BY 1,2),
DayEvents AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,DATE_DIFF('day',DATE '2026-07-29',CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE)) day_n,e."$part_date" d,e."#account_id" aid,e."#event_time" et,e."#event_name" ev FROM ta.v_event_18 e LEFT JOIN TCB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111')
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,DATE_DIFF('day',DATE '2026-05-08',CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE)),e."$part_date",e."#account_id",e."#event_time",e."#event_name" FROM ta.v_event_13 e JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SGB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-05-08' AND '2026-05-12' AND b.u IS NULL),
DailyUsers AS (SELECT grp,day_n,d,aid FROM DayEvents WHERE ev='login' AND aid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3,4),
Gaps AS (SELECT grp,day_n,d,aid,DATE_DIFF('second',CAST(et AS TIMESTAMP),LEAD(CAST(et AS TIMESTAMP)) OVER(PARTITION BY grp,d,aid ORDER BY et)) gap FROM DayEvents WHERE ev NOT LIKE '%app%' AND aid IS NOT NULL),
Duration AS (SELECT u.grp,u.day_n,u.d,u.aid,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gap BETWEEN 0 AND 119 THEN g.gap ELSE 0 END),0)/60.0 mins FROM DailyUsers u LEFT JOIN Gaps g ON u.grp=g.grp AND u.day_n=g.day_n AND u.d=g.d AND u.aid=g.aid GROUP BY 1,2,3,4),
DurationAgg AS (SELECT grp,day_n,COUNT(*) users,ROUND(AVG(mins),2) avg_mins,APPROX_PERCENTILE(mins,0.5) median_mins,COUNT(CASE WHEN mins>=60 THEN 1 END) over60 FROM Duration GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT 'guide' "数据模块",a.grp "对比组",NULL "相对日",a.ord "排序",CONCAT(CAST(a.ord AS VARCHAR),'.',a.name) "项目",a.users "用户数",ROUND(100.0*a.users/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT did) FROM GuideCohort c WHERE c.grp=a.grp),0),2) "占比(%)",NULL "平均在线分钟",NULL "在线中位数分钟" FROM GuideAgg a
UNION ALL
SELECT 'duration',grp,day_n,NULL,CONCAT('D',CAST(day_n AS VARCHAR),' 全量DAU'),users,ROUND(100.0*over60/NULLIF(users,0),2),avg_mins,median_mins FROM DurationAgg
ORDER BY 1,2,3,4;
